en: A philatelic postcard or first day cover commemorating the XXVI Summer Olympic Games. On the right is a large block of three Estonian postage stamps featuring Olympic themes: a medal, a victorious athlete with raised arms, and a swimmer on the starting block. Above them are five interlinked Olympic rings and text. There are cancellation marks dated 25.IV.1996 from Tallinn. On the left is a triangular pattern of small blue human figures forming a stylized tree, with text below referring to Atlanta 1996 and FDC. An Olympic logo and Estonian text with the date and Tallinn are also printed near the top, with a handwritten signature in the middle.
